name: switch
purpose: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately, built on a native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> with a track and thumb. Switches have no required state; validity is valid unless a custom error is set (for example when saving the setting failed).
whenToUse: A binary setting that applies immediately, such as enabling notifications or dark mode.
Settings pages where each row toggles one feature.
whenNotToUse: A choice that is only applied when a form is submitted: use Checkbox.
A choice the user must confirm ("I agree"): use a required Checkbox.
More than two states: use Radio Group or Select.
responsive: The track is fixed-size (switch-width by switch-height tokens); the label wraps next to it and help text aligns with the label. The row is at least touch-target-min tall and the label extends the hit target.
rtl: The thumb is positioned with inset-inline-start, so "on" moves the thumb to the inline end in both directions (right in LTR, left in RTL) without extra rules.
theme: Off: color-surface-sunken track with a color-border-strong boundary and thumb. On: color-primary track with a color-on-primary thumb. The state is carried by thumb position as well as color. Forced-colors mode uses Canvas/CanvasText (off), Highlight/HighlightText (on), and GrayText (disabled) with forced-color-adjust: none. Reduced motion removes the thumb transition.
security: Label, help text, and messages are rendered with textContent. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. With `name`, the native input submits `name=value` when on, like a checkbox.

budgets.budget: < 1 ms average in headless Chromium (target; not yet covered by the performance test)

performance.testedScale: Unit-tested per instance; not yet included in the 1,000-instance performance test.

limitations: No `required` or `validate` option: a switch is a setting, not a question. Use setCustomError to report a failed save.
No built-in on/off text inside the track; the label must describe the setting.
The track is 2.25rem by 1.25rem; the 24px minimum target is met by the row and the clickable label, not the track alone.
antiPatterns: Using a switch inside a form whose changes are applied only on submit.
Changing the label text with the state ("On"/"Off"); the state is already announced.
Requiring a switch to be on.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/switch: AuiSwitch directive ([auiSwitch]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/switch: AuiSwitch component; controlled (checked/defaultChecked + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
